supported.answer: An agreement is a contract when the parties agree freely, are able to contract, and the agreement has a lawful payment or exchange and a lawful purpose. It must also not be declared void by law.
supported.quote: All agreements are contracts if they are made by the free consent of parties competent to contract, for a lawful consideration and with a lawful object, and are not hereby expressly declared to be void.

unsupported.answer: I can only answer questions that are supported by sections 1 to 30 of the Contract Act, 1872. I could not find support for this question.
